method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: As Yields Surged, Small-Cap Stocks Were Hit Hard
Equities.reason: Directly links rising yields to a distinct equity-market outcome (small-cap underperformance). Strong macro liquidity/yields narrative is negative for risk assets and cyclical/small-cap exposure, so high relevance and negative direction.

Equities.title: Big Tech Rally Extends Into Fourth Week as AI Bubble Fears Fade
Equities.reason: Reinforces dominant market regime: AI-led tech leadership and risk-on flows. Important market-wide equity narrative supporting broad indices — positive for large-cap tech and overall sentiment.

Equities.title: The hazy OpenAI growth metric driving Wall Street
Equities.summary: Revelations that the AI giant’s annualised revenues were $20bn less than previously reported triggered volatility in US stocks
Equities.reason: AI revenue clarity/metrics are a core driver of tech valuations. Negative surprise/opacity increases volatility for AI-exposed names and can dent the AI leadership narrative.

Equities.title: The world of one trade — AI
Equities.summary: Investor portfolios have become alarmingly reliant on the fortunes of just one bet on the build-out of an uncertain technology
Equities.reason: Highlights concentration risk from one dominant thematic (AI). This cautionary, market-structure narrative raises downside risk for portfolios heavily exposed to the AI trade — material for broad equities.

Equities.title: Living with Mom and trading on margin. The regular investor gets in on Wall Street's record stock borrowing binge
Equities.summary: Margin debt has surged to record levels as investors like 29-year-old Hy Luu borrow more against their portfolios. Here’s how leverage can amplify stock losses.
Equities.reason: Record margin borrowing increases tail-risk for an equity pullback; leverage amplifies selloffs and is a negative backdrop for market stability and risk appetite.

Equities.title: Beaten Down Loans from Proofpoint, Sophos Climb as AI Fears Ease
Equities.reason: Improving credit prices for previously weak AI-linked names signals easing sector stress and supports the narrative that AI fears are receding — modestly positive for tech and cyclical sentiment.

Equities.title: Two massive trades just happened in Micron and Nvidia. What they could mean for chips
Equities.summary: Bears continued to build up positions against the semiconductor group on Friday.
Equities.reason: Notable large bearish positioning in key semiconductor names (Micron, Nvidia) signals market caution within a strategically important sector; negative for chip/AI supply-chain sentiment.

Equities.title: S&P 500 Rises to Near-Record Level Before Earnings: Markets Wrap
Equities.reason: Broad-index strength ahead of earnings indicates constructive risk appetite and momentum in large caps; supports the near-term risk-on backdrop for equities.

Equities.title: Data Center Darling’s $30 Billion IPO Dream Crushed in 48 Hours
Equities.reason: A high-profile IPO failure signals a tougher fundraising environment for tech and data-center plays; negative for supply of new risk assets and sentiment in the sector.

Equities.title: AI IPO market facing higher bar from investors
Equities.reason: Investors raising scrutiny on AI IPOs reduces near-term capital flows into the theme; modest negative for the AI-driven issuance narrative.

Equities.title: US consumer sentiment deteriorates further in October
Equities.reason: Weaker consumer sentiment points to potential softness in consumer-driven earnings and reduces cyclical risk appetite — negative for broad equities, especially consumer cyclicals.

Rates.title: Here’s how Treasury yields could rise to 6% — even without market upheaval
Rates.reason: Analysis suggests materially higher Treasury yields are plausible even in an orderly scenario — reinforces higher-for-longer / bond selloff narrative and is an important negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Mortgage rates surge to highest level since 2023 as bond yields spike
Rates.reason: Mortgage rates moving higher in step with a rise in bond yields — transmission from Treasury/IG selloff to consumer borrowing costs; negative for fixed-income prices.

Rates.title: 10-year Treasury yield could 'tick a little bit higher': Kenny Polcari
Rates.reason: Market commentary expecting modest further upside in the 10-year — supports ongoing upward yield pressure, modestly negative for bonds.

Rates.title: European bank stocks slide as bond yields spark investor caution
Rates.reason: Rising bond yields are causing market-wide risk repricing (banks hit) — reinforces sovereign/corporate selloff narrative and higher term premia.

Rates.title: Wall Street’s Rate Shock Spreads Beneath AI-Fueled Market Rally
Rates.reason: Headline captures broadening rate-driven stress beneath equity strength — significant reinforcement of a rate-selloff / higher-for-longer regime, negative for bonds.

Rates.title: Liberty Meetings Draw Crowd in London as Virgin Media Bonds Sink
Rates.reason: Idiosyncratic corporate bond weakness (Virgin Media) signalling stress in credit markets as yields rise — negative for corporate bond prices and credit spreads.

Rates.title: Junk bonds are 'flashing yellow.' Watch these warning signs
Rates.summary: Spreads have widened in the high-yield bond market, but that doesn't tell the whole story.
Rates.reason: Widening high-yield spreads indicate credit tightening and risk-off within fixed income — negative for credit markets and supportive of higher term premia.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, September 15-16, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, September 15-16, 2026
Rates.reason: FOMC minutes are a primary input to rate expectations; recent minutes have reinforced a hawkish/higher-for-longer tone — meaningful negative signal for bond prices.

Rates.title: Japanese Yen struggles as wide US-Japan yield gap weighs
Rates.summary: USD/JPY trades with a positive bias on Friday as the Japanese Yen (JPY) underperforms across the board following a sharp decline in Japanese government bond yields.
Rates.reason: Sharp decline in JGB yields is a local counter-signal (bond rally in Japan) — positive for Japanese government bonds and offsets some global selloff narrative.

Rates.title: Trump created a committee to dig into the Fed's Lisa Cook. What is it and what comes next?
Rates.summary: Trump’s bid to fire the Fed's Lisa Cook follows a Supreme Court ruling and could affect Jerome Powell, central bank independence and interest rates.
Rates.reason: Political pressure on Fed governance raises tail risks to central bank credibility and term premia — modest negative for bond markets, but lower relevance than market-driven yield moves.

Rates.title: Treasury's Bessent hires Trump's controversial former Fed board pick, Judy Shelton, as advisor
Rates.summary: Shelton's controversial economic ideas led the Senate to block her nomination to the Fed. Now she's going to be a counselor to the Treasury secretary.
Rates.reason: Appointment of a controversial advisor to Treasury could shift policy rhetoric or increase uncertainty around fiscal/monetary interplay — small negative for bond markets with limited immediate impact.

FX.reason: Domestic political risks and contested budget process increase sovereign/fiscal risk for France — a clear negative driver for EUR and relevant to EURUSD and core euro-area spreads.

FX.title: Euro struggles as French fiscal concerns and firm US Dollar dominate

FX.title: Krugman Says France Poses Risk of Explosive European Debt Crisis

FX.title: Dollar Index stalls under its high as the Fed's hawks repeat themselves

FX.reason: DXY failing to sustain new highs implies USD is stalling — supportive for non‑USD pairs (EUR/GBP/AUD/CAD/JPY) and relevant for broad FX positioning.

FX.title: Breaking: UoM Consumer Sentiment Index declines to 46.3 in October
FX.summary: American consumer confidence declined in early October, as households grew more pessimistic about current conditions and the broader economic outlook, according to preliminary data from the University of Michigan.
FX.reason: Weaker US consumer sentiment is a USD-negative macro datapoint that can weigh on USD; direct transmission into FX flows makes this relevant.

FX.title: Canada loses 68.3K jobs and the Loonie falls to an 18-month low

FX.reason: Material negative Canadian payroll surprise drove USD/CAD higher and weakened CAD — clear FX-native shock with solid relevance for CAD/USD pricing and cross‑asset flows.

FX.summary: Commerzbank analysts note Taiwan’s September trade surplus hit a record USD23.6bn, with exports surging 60.9% year-on-year on strong AI-related demand. The Central Bank of the Republic of China may lean more hawkish if inflation’s uptrend persists.
FX.reason: Record trade surplus and AI-driven export strength are supportive for TWD vs USD; possible CB tightening reduces depreciation risk — FX-native, moderate relevance.

FX.reason: Stronger Chinese trade and price pressure is a supportive fundamental for the yuan and could reduce USD outperformance in EM/Asia — direct FX transmission and meaningful relevance.

FX.summary: Commerzbank’s FX team highlights that the People’s Bank of China rejected claims the yuan is undervalued, linking export strength to industrial competitiveness rather than currency manipulation.
FX.reason: Reinforces PBoC messaging that should tamp down volatility and depreciation narratives — supportive but lower relevance compared with trade/price datapoints.

FX.title: Asia FX: Trade negotiations and resilient macro backdrop – MUFG

FX.reason: Japanese investor flows into/out of foreign bonds can move global yields and influence USD; reported selling of US bonds implies upward pressure on US rates/USD — modest negative for non‑USD FX.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar edges higher on softer US yields, Fed hike bets cap recovery
FX.summary: NZD/USD trades around 0.5605 on Friday at the time of writing, posting a modest gain of 0.06% on the day, but more broadly continuing to consolidate near its recent lows.
FX.reason: Softer US yields provide near‑term support for NZD vs USD, but constrained by Fed hike expectations — modest FX impact and moderate relevance.

FX.title: Aussie extends weekly gains as Fed pause bets offset hawkish rhetoric
FX.summary: The Aussie Dollar ended Friday’s session on a positive note, gaining 0.38% and 0.58% weekly as the US Dollar trimmed some of its weekly gains, while US data confirmed investors' expectations that the Federal Reserve would hold rates steady in the October meeti

FX.title: British Pound holds ground as US Consumer Sentiment deteriorates
FX.summary: The Pound Sterling (GBP) holds firm against the US Dollar (USD) on Friday, which posts modest gains against a basket of six currencies, while US consumers grow pessimistic about the economy as the US-Iran conflict drags on for another week.
FX.reason: Deteriorating US sentiment and risk factors support GBP vs USD (or at least cap USD strength); FX‑native and moderately relevant for G10 flows.

Commodities.reason: Positioning shifts (CTA short-covering) plus Chinese ETF inflows are structural bullish flows that reinforce the price move; medium-high relevance.

Commodities.title: Hurricane Isaias Shuts Almost Three-Quarters of Gulf Oil Output
Commodities.reason: Large, near-term supply outage in Gulf production is an acute bullish shock to crude fundamentals — exceptional supply-side impact, high relevance.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur

Commodities.title: Crude oil prices and refinery margins generally increased throughout the third quarter
Commodities.summary: Petroleum markets in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26) were characterized by increasing prices for crude oil and petroleum products amid persistent conflict in the Middle East.
Commodities.reason: EIA-confirmed Q3 strength tied to Middle East conflict underlines ongoing upward pressure on crude and product margins — supports bullish oil narrative.

Commodities.title: Crude Oil drops on Trump's Russian diesel plan
Commodities.summary: After a call with Russian President Putin, President Donald Trump said on Friday Russia will immediately supply more than 300K tons of diesel to the US and global markets. He put the next shipments at 500K tons in November and 1 million tons after that.
Commodities.reason: Near-term increase in diesel/product supply from Russia acts as a supply easing narrative and weighs on crude prices; clear short-term bearish signal.

Commodities.title: China’s Oil Imports Look Set to Rise as Supertanker Fleet Swells
Commodities.reason: Increasing Chinese import capacity via larger tanker fleet implies stronger physical demand prospects — bullish demand-side cue for crude.

Commodities.title: U.S. natural gas production reached a record high in July 2026

Commodities.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Pick Up in Early Trading
Commodities.reason: Intraday futures pick-up is a short-term positive move but low relevance versus structural production increases; treated as transient counter-signal.

Commodities.title: Corn Falls Most Since 2023 After USDA Hikes US Crop in Surprise
Commodities.reason: USDA raising US yield outlook is a material negative for corn supply expectations — large price reaction suggests meaningful bearish fundamental update.

Commodities.title: The world needs Ukraine’s grain. Its farmers are running out of reasons to plant

Commodities.reason: Potential drop in Ukrainian plantings/export availability is a supply risk for global grains and could tighten markets — constructive for grain prices.

Commodities.title: Airlines sound the alarm as bleak winter looms

Commodities.reason: EIA expects lower natural gas-driven expenditures in parts of winter — reinforces softer natural gas price outlook (moderate relevance).

Crypto.reason: Geopolitical de‑escalation lifted risk appetite and drove a BTC price rebound — short-term positive for crypto flows and liquidations. Market-move story with moderate relevance.

Crypto.title: Ether bets were wiped out at six times bitcoin’s rate in crypto’s $1 billion flush
Crypto.reason: Large leveraged liquidations, especially concentrated in ETH, amplify downside volatility and risk-aversion — negative for risk sentiment in crypto markets.

Crypto.reason: Sovereign sanctions on exchanges are a major regulatory/legal shock that can disrupt flows and on/off ramps — material negative for market access and compliance costs.

Crypto.reason: New on-ledger controls aimed at banks/stablecoins enhance institutional suitability and compliance — positive for tokenization and regulated use-cases on XRPL.

Crypto.reason: Tokenization narrative signals capital markets adoption beyond BTC/ETH and potential new demand sources — constructive for structural growth in crypto markets.
